cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Your garden gnome is coming home in a different arrangement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Several pieces, carefully packed. I wanted you to hear 'coming home' first.

beats.speaker: A

mechanism: A treats its former repair pupil careful questioning as progress while revealing a returned gnome is in pieces and not all pieces survived.
confusable: Not a single blunt admission followed by reassurance: each layer changes what coming home or repair means while protecting B from all the loss at once.
comparison: Wedding plan disruption versus partial recovery of sentimental object.
